tool_arguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original game-environment statue concept, raster image only.
Primary request: One original full-body Roman/Renaissance marble sculpture of a mature adult woman desperately crawling and reaching toward escape from an unseen infernal place. This is nonsexual dramatic classical sculpture expressing human courage and anguish.
Subject and pose: Low forward crawling/lunging composition. One bent knee and the opposite palm support her weight; the other leg trails naturally. Her free arm reaches forward and upward toward freedom, with a fully readable reaching hand and separated natural fingers. Her face turns toward that reaching hand, brow strained, jaw tense, torso twisting with effort. Balanced plausible anatomy and a distinct expressive silhouette. Both feet visible and anatomically coherent. Fine detailed adult face, hands, carved hair and cloth folds.
Garment: a short lightweight opaque sleeveless Roman tunica, hem above the knees, covering torso and pelvis completely in this moving pose. Fine cloth folds carved into marble, dignified nonsexual drapery.
Material: the entire woman, every limb, hair, and tunica are one continuous pale warm aged marble sculpture, very subtle stone pores and veins, refined Roman/Renaissance carving.
Composition/framing: isolated full body, rough front three-quarter sculptural catalog view with modest perspective. Camera at sculpture eye level but high enough to see her face and reaching hand clearly. Entire form in frame with at least 8 percent clear margin on every side.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background. No ground or environment.
Lighting: neutral soft studio lighting with gentle form-defining shadows on the sculpture.
Constraints: exactly one woman sculpture. No plinth, platform, pedestal, base, ledge, text, lettering, watermark, goat motifs, or gothic ornament. No scene, flames, creatures, extra limbs, merged fingers, injury, restraint, sexual activity, nudity, eroticized suffering, glamour posing, or suggestive camera angle. Do not include any solid background. This is an original sculpture concept, no 3D model or mesh output.
